metadata.title: त्रिपुरा की जमातिया जनजाति की गोरिया पूजा | Garia celebration of Jamatia tribe in Tripura
metadata.description:
Garia puja is a traditional festival celebrated by the tribes of Tripura, a state in northeast India. The festival is primarily dedicated to the deity Garia, who is considered to be the god of wealth, livestock and fertility. The festival is usually held during April and May.

During the Garia puja festival, people perform various rituals and offerings to the deity Garia. These rituals usually involve dancing, singing, and offering food, drinks and other items to the deity. The festival is also marked by the sacrifice of animals, such as goats or buffaloes, as an offering to the deity.

The Garia puja festival is an important cultural event for the tribes of Tripura, as it is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity to the community. People also have to come together, socialize, and celebrate their traditions and heritage.
